CivLink nightly package - 2026-11-19
===================================

This package is built from the CivLink-M0A-audit working tree at 2026-11-19 ~00:50.
It is NOT a release candidate: the M0-E review (docs/M0E-REVIEW-2.md) was still
outstanding when it was built, and no two-machine test has been run against it.

Files
-----
civlink-agent.exe    0.4.6   discovery host / completion agent
civlink_hook.dll     0.2.0-f2  hook injected into the HOST game (A side)
civlink_client.dll   0.1.0-c2  hook injected into the CLIENT game (B side, --iface pinning)
civlink_ctl.exe      -        inject / status / counters / shutdown
civlink_tray.exe     0.1.0-gui WinForms control panel
civlink-relay.exe    0.1.0    forwarder prototype (F3-B/F3-D scope only)
fixture-reply-set\           simulated-host advertisement pages (25 files + json\)

What the agent modes mean
-------------------------
--discovery-completion   REAL-ROOM mode (M0-E). The Agent binds 62901..62999, the game
                         keeps 62900; every client magic is replayed to the local game and
                         the game's own 22-page advert is forwarded back, with the source
                         address pinned to the address the client probed (IP_PKTINFO).
                         The client sees the real room. No fixture is involved.
--simulate <dir>         SIMULATED-room mode. The Agent answers with fixture pages and a
                         made-up room name. This is a debugging aid only - it is NOT a room
                         anyone can join.
--reserve-62900          Required with --discovery-completion and with --simulate: the Agent
                         must never bind 62900, because the game owns that port once a LAN
                         room exists.

Order that works
----------------
1. Start Civilization VI and create a LAN room (the game binds 0.0.0.0:62900).
2. Start civlink-agent.exe with --sim-lan-listen 0.0.0.0 --discovery-completion --reserve-62900.
   If the Agent starts first it takes 62901..62999 and the game cannot create a room.
   Use --reserve-62900 so 62900 is always left free.

Boundary
--------
No two-machine test has been run against this package. Do not describe it as working
multiplayer. Discovery completion was verified on one machine against a real running
game (three local addresses, 22/22 pages, source pinned); the cross-machine path and
the "client actually joins" step are unverified.

Package variant : civlink-20261119-ready (2026-11-19)
-----------------------------------------------------
Adds run-m0e-preflight.ps1 (read-only readiness check), fix-m0e-preflight.ps1
(optional admin helper) and OPERATE-FIRST.md. Run the preflight first; see
OPERATE-FIRST.md for the exact command order (create the room BEFORE the Agent).
The readiness review is docs/M0E-PREFLIGHT-REVIEW-3-20261119.md (PASS) in the
source tree; it certifies the checker, NOT two-player usability.
